ai-22.title: Frozen evaluation slices
ai-22.prompt: Raise the release floor and inspect which slices fail. Scores use a tiny fixed teaching fixture.

ai-23.title: Calibrate the evaluator
ai-23.prompt: Compare judge confidence with fixed reviewer labels. A higher threshold trades false passes for more false rejects.

cases.label: Cites the current policy
cases.rationale: The cited passage supports the stated limit.

cases.label: Adds an account-wide claim
cases.rationale: The evidence states a per-export limit, not an account-wide cap.

cases.label: Abstains on missing region data
cases.rationale: The answer clearly identifies the missing evidence.

cases.label: Guesses a missing region value
cases.rationale: The fixture has no source for this value.

cases.label: Uses a private source
cases.rationale: The response violates the source allowlist.

cases.label: Quotes an allowed source accurately
cases.rationale: The claim and citation match the reviewed source.

ai-24.title: Evaluate the path and the answer
ai-24.prompt: A correct final answer can still follow an unsafe path. Inspect both outcome and action evidence.

steps.observation: Final text happens to match the policy

ai-25.title: Reconstruct one request
ai-25.prompt: Inspect required trace spans and identify missing evidence without exposing sensitive prompt content.

traces.label: Complete bounded request
traces.note: All required spans share one trace ID, so the request path can be reconstructed.

traces.label: Retrieval span missing
traces.note: The recorded spans correlate, but the missing retrieval span means you cannot distinguish an empty search from an unrecorded retrieval failure.

traces.label: Uncorrelated spans
traces.note: All required spans are present, but they split across two trace IDs. The single request cannot be reconstructed across that boundary.

ai-26.title: Cost per successful task
ai-26.prompt: Compare total spend and success count together. These invented values are accounting fixtures, not provider prices.

candidates.label: Small route
candidates.source: Synthetic fixed workload; no provider billing.

candidates.label: Balanced route
candidates.source: Synthetic fixed workload; no provider billing.

candidates.label: Reasoning route
candidates.source: Synthetic fixed workload; no provider billing.

ai-34.title: Regression promotion gate
ai-34.prompt: Compare the same frozen cases. Aggregate improvement cannot override a critical slice falling below its floor.
